import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
product_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='#8B4513')
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sales by Hour
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#D2691E')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Hour')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = ['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#CD853F']
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution')

# 4. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax4.bar(range(len(age_sales)), age_sales.values, color='#A0522D')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(age_sales)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(age_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Age Group')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax5.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E'])
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Product Size Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
ax6.bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=['#CD853F', '#D2691E', '#8B4513'])
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Orders')
ax6.set_title('Product Size Distribution')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Average Price by Product
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
avg_price = df.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
avg_price.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax7, color='#A0522D')
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Price ($)')
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product')
ax7.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Quantity Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
quantity_counts = df['quantity'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax8.bar(quantity_counts.index, quantity_counts.values, color='#8B4513')
ax8.set_xlabel('Quantity per Order')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax8.set_title('Quantity Distribution')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Heatmap: Product vs Size
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
pivot_table = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
pivot_table = pivot_table.reindex(columns=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'], fill_value=0)
sns.heatmap(pivot_table, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrBr', ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'label': 'Total Sales ($)'})
ax9.set_title('Sales Heatmap: Product vs Size')

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
